dialogues.en: I get out of bed while stretching.
dialogues.text: I get out of bed while stretching.

dialogues.en: "I guess I just woke up when you came to wake me up."
dialogues.text: "I guess I just woke up when you came to wake me up."

dialogues.jp: 「……おはよ」
dialogues.en:
I yawn and murmur, not to her but to myself. Then, she
shakes her head from side to side.
dialogues.text:
I yawn and murmur, not to her but to myself. Then, she
shakes her head from side to side.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます……」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not what happened......"
dialogues.text: "No, that's not what happened......"

dialogues.jp:
目を開くと、何の前触れもなく、そこには頼子
さんの顔が。驚きにしばらく固まってしまった。
dialogues.en:
"Really? So you tried to wake me up but I didn't wake up for
a long time?"
dialogues.text:
"Really? So you tried to wake me up but I didn't wake up for
a long time?"

dialogues.en:
It can happen. I can hang onto my sleep tightly like a beast
won't let go of meat.
dialogues.text:
It can happen. I can hang onto my sleep tightly like a beast
won't let go of meat.

dialogues.jp: ぐっと伸びをしつつベッドから起きあがる。
dialogues.en: But she shakes her head from side to side again.
dialogues.text: But she shakes her head from side to side again.

dialogues.jp: 「起こしに来たら、丁度目が覚めたのかな」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
あくびをしながら、頼子さんにというよりは、
独り言のように呟く。と、彼女は首を振った。
dialogues.en: I have a big question mark on my face, then......
dialogues.text: I have a big question mark on my face, then......

dialogues.jp:
野獣のように眠りをぼりぼり｛むさぼ／貪｝っていたのかも。
俺ならあり得る。
dialogues.en: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!
dialogues.text: Beep-beep-beep-beep-beep!

dialogues.jp: しかし、それにも首を振った。
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.en: As I turn off the alarm, Yoriko-san says,
dialogues.text: As I turn off the alarm, Yoriko-san says,

dialogues.jp: 顔に疑問符を浮かべてしまう。と──。
dialogues.en: "Ah...... I was waiting 'till it went off."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... I was waiting 'till it went off."

dialogues.jp: ジリリリリ！
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 「よっと」
dialogues.en:
Her face turns red. Now I have two big question marks on my
face.
dialogues.text:
Her face turns red. Now I have two big question marks on my
face.

dialogues.jp:
俺が音をストップさせるのと同時に、頼子さん
は言った。
dialogues.en: "Huh? Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あの……それまでは、待っていようと思った
　んです」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何が？」
dialogues.en: "I was watching...... you sleep."
dialogues.text: "I was watching...... you sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉さんを、起こすのをです……」
何故か、頬を赤らめる。疑問符が二つに増える。
dialogues.en: "Watching me?"
dialogues.text: "Watching me?"

dialogues.en: She hesitantly nods. ......She's squirming.
dialogues.text: She hesitantly nods. ......She's squirming.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en:
"......You have poor taste. I could understand if you want
to watch a celebrity's sleeping face, but me?"
dialogues.text:
"......You have poor taste. I could understand if you want
to watch a celebrity's sleeping face, but me?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「寝顔を……見てました」
dialogues.en: "I have good taste."
dialogues.text: "I have good taste."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Then, you have poor eyesight."
dialogues.text: "Then, you have poor eyesight."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「俺の？」
dialogues.en: "My eyes are good."
dialogues.text: "My eyes are good."

dialogues.jp:
もじもじしながら、こくんと頷く。……器用な
動きだな。

「……そりゃあ、趣味が悪いな。どこぞの名画
　ならともかく、俺の顔じゃあね」
dialogues.en:
I'm about to criticize her beauty sense next, but I don't
because I don't want to hear her say yes this time...
dialogues.text:
I'm about to criticize her beauty sense next, but I don't
because I don't want to hear her say yes this time...

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことありませんよ……」
dialogues.en: "I'll make breakfast soon."
dialogues.text: "I'll make breakfast soon."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、目が悪いんだ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
じゃ、美意識かなと思いつつも、それは口にし
ない。言ってて泣きそうになるからな。
制服に着替えつつ、ふと疑問に思った。
dialogues.en: While I change into my school uniform, I'm thinking.
dialogues.text: While I change into my school uniform, I'm thinking.

dialogues.jp:
「そもそも、何で俺の寝顔なんぞ見てたんだろ
　うな？」
dialogues.en: "Why was she watching my sleeping face anyway?"
dialogues.text: "Why was she watching my sleeping face anyway?"

dialogues.jp: 「照れるじゃねえか、こんちきしょうめ」
dialogues.en: "Man, I'm blushing......"
dialogues.text: "Man, I'm blushing......"

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、行ってきま〜す」
dialogues.en: "I'm leaving."
dialogues.text: "I'm leaving."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「行ってらっしゃい」
dialogues.en: "Have a nice day."
dialogues.text: "Have a nice day."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さて……と」
寂しげな笑顔に送り出され、学園へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
She sends me off with a sad smile, and I start to walk to
school.
dialogues.text:
She sends me off with a sad smile, and I start to walk to
school.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず天井が抜けたように桜が降る中を、
いつものごとく学生達がぞろりと歩いている。
dialogues.en:
As usual, students are walking to school through falling
petals of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
As usual, students are walking to school through falling
petals of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.jp: そして、当然のように、俺の隣には誰も居ない。
dialogues.en: And as usual, I don't have anyone next to me.
dialogues.text: And as usual, I don't have anyone next to me.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ……日常の光景ってやつだよな」
dialogues.en: "This is called an ordinary sight."
dialogues.text: "This is called an ordinary sight."

dialogues.jp:
見慣れた道を、見慣れた制服が行く中で、俺は
一人てくてくやっている。
dialogues.en:
I'm walking alone along the familiar road with students
wearing the familiar school uniforms.
dialogues.text:
I'm walking alone along the familiar road with students
wearing the familiar school uniforms.

dialogues.jp:
あんな夢を見たせいで、つい自分の足が着いて
いる地を確認したくなってしまったのだ。
dialogues.en:
Since I had that dream last night, I want to check if my
feet are definitely touching the ground.
dialogues.text:
Since I had that dream last night, I want to check if my
feet are definitely touching the ground.

dialogues.jp: 「……不毛の土地だ」
dialogues.en: "......Dead soil."
dialogues.text: "......Dead soil."

dialogues.jp:
ペンペン草一本生えていないという事実に、割
と切なくなってしまう。
dialogues.en:
There isn't even a weed growing on this road, and that fact
makes me feel a bit lonely.
dialogues.text:
There isn't even a weed growing on this road, and that fact
makes me feel a bit lonely.

dialogues.jp: 「くぅ……こんな学園生活に誰がした」
dialogues.en: "Who made my school life so miserable?"
dialogues.text: "Who made my school life so miserable?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いようっ、やっぱり今朝も、財布落としたよ
　うな顔だなっ、朝倉」
dialogues.en:
"Hey! Why do you always look sad in the morning? You look
like you lost your wallet or something."
dialogues.text:
"Hey! Why do you always look sad in the morning? You look
like you lost your wallet or something."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あーあー。うんうん。ペンペン草」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, yeah. Yes, yes. Weed, weed."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, yeah. Yes, yes. Weed, weed."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「肩を叩きつつ意味不明な単語。金属片でも、
　埋め込まれたか？」
dialogues.en:
"What are you talking about......? Were you abducted by
aliens and now you have a piece of metal in your brain?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you talking about......? Were you abducted by
aliens and now you have a piece of metal in your brain?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「知るか」
dialogues.en: "How would I know that?"
dialogues.text: "How would I know that?"

dialogues.jp:
月とスッポンどころか、月とカメムシくらいの
差があるが、杉並が横に並ぶ。
dialogues.en:
It's as different as night and day, but Suginami's walking
next to me now.
dialogues.text:
It's as different as night and day, but Suginami's walking
next to me now.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「今日は、お前に報告があってな」
dialogues.en: "Today I have something to tell you."
dialogues.text: "Today I have something to tell you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あん？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「水越をプロレスに誘ってみたぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I asked Mako if she wanted to go watch a pro wrestling
match with me."
dialogues.text:
"I asked Mako if she wanted to go watch a pro wrestling
match with me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おう。どうだった？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, what did she say?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, what did she say?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ナノ１秒ほどで却下された」
dialogues.en: "She told me no in a second."
dialogues.text: "She told me no in a second."

dialogues.jp:
笑っていいのやらどうなのやら、判断に苦しむ
ところではあるな……。
dialogues.en: I don't know if I should have laughed or not.
dialogues.text: I don't know if I should have laughed or not.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「予想以上にガードが堅いな。どうやら多少、
　作戦変更をせねばならんようだ」
dialogues.en:
"Then, ask her if she wants to go to watch a movie.
Anyway......"
dialogues.text:
"Then, ask her if she wants to go to watch a movie.
Anyway......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、だったら、今度は無難に映画にでも誘っ
　てみろよ。ところで……」
dialogues.en: "Do you like our school?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like our school?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おまえ、学園に通うのは好きか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes? I don't hate it."
dialogues.text: "Yes? I don't hate it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うん？　まあ、嫌いではないが」
dialogues.en: "You don't hate it......"
dialogues.text: "You don't hate it......"

dialogues.jp:
当たり障りのない答えだ。だが、そんなものか
もしれない。
dialogues.en:
That's a generic answer, and maybe that's the best answer as
well.
dialogues.text:
That's a generic answer, and maybe that's the best answer as
well.

dialogues.jp: 例えばの話だけど、と俺は先を続けた。
dialogues.en: I ask him more with an example.
dialogues.text: I ask him more with an example.

dialogues.jp:
「おまえが病気か何かで１ヶ月休んだとする。
　１ヶ月ぶりの登校をどう感じると思う？」
dialogues.en:
"For example, if you missed school for a month because you
got sick, how do you think you'd feel when you go back to
school after a month?"
dialogues.text:
"For example, if you missed school for a month because you
got sick, how do you think you'd feel when you go back to
school after a month?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そりゃ、嬉しいだろ。決まってる」
dialogues.en: "......Of course I'd be happy."
dialogues.text: "......Of course I'd be happy."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おい、何の話だ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だろうなあ」
dialogues.en: "I don't know."
dialogues.text: "I don't know."

dialogues.jp:
遠くを眺めつつ、すっとぼける。ぐいぐいと、
我が｛まなびや／学舎｝が近づいてくる。
dialogues.en:
I look into the distance and play dumb. We're getting closer
to school.
dialogues.text:
I look into the distance and play dumb. We're getting closer
to school.

dialogues.jp:
これまで、学園ってのは“当たり前”だと思っ
ていた。
dialogues.en: To me, it was a given that everybody goes to school.
dialogues.text: To me, it was a given that everybody goes to school.

dialogues.jp:
当たり前のようにそこにあって、当たり前のよ
うにそこへ通う。
dialogues.en:
There's a school, and students go there as a matter of
course.
dialogues.text:
There's a school, and students go there as a matter of
course.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、それが当たり前じゃないって人が居る
のも、これまた｛しか／然｝りってなものなのだ。
dialogues.en:
But it's not a given for some people, and that's all too
real as well.
dialogues.text:
But it's not a given for some people, and that's all too
real as well.

dialogues.jp:
（頼子さん……もしかして、自分も行きたいの
　かな……）
dialogues.en:
(Yoriko-san...... I wonder if she wants to go to school as
well......)
dialogues.text:
(Yoriko-san...... I wonder if she wants to go to school as
well......)

dialogues.jp: （だから、寂しげな顔で送り出す……？）
dialogues.en: (Is that why she looks sad when she sends me off...?)
dialogues.text: (Is that why she looks sad when she sends me off...?)

dialogues.jp:
しかし、頼子さんは外に出る事に恐怖を感じて
いる。昨夜の拒絶からすれば、それはかなり強
いみたいだ。
dialogues.en:
But she's scared of going outside. From the way she reacted
last night, I can tell she really hates to go outside.
dialogues.text:
But she's scared of going outside. From the way she reacted
last night, I can tell she really hates to go outside.

dialogues.jp: そんな彼女が、一体どうしたら……？
dialogues.en: Is there any way she can go to school......?
dialogues.text: Is there any way she can go to school......?

dialogues.jp: （……通信教育？　いや、それはまた別だよな）
dialogues.en: "......Online study? No, it's different......"
dialogues.text: "......Online study? No, it's different......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何、ぶつぶつ呟きながら歩いてるんだ。不気
　味すぎるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You're usually weird, but today you're very weird. If you
feel bad about making me ask Mako to a pro wrestler match,
you don't have to worry."
dialogues.text:
"You're usually weird, but today you're very weird. If you
feel bad about making me ask Mako to a pro wrestler match,
you don't have to worry."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、このままずっと考えても頼子さんのこと
はすぐに決着がつきそうもないから、仕方なく
杉並の話に付き合うことにする。
dialogues.en: "......I appreciate it."
dialogues.text: "......I appreciate it."

dialogues.jp:
「で？　新たな候補地はどうするんだ？　それ
　とも、諦めるか？」
dialogues.en:
"So? Where are you going to ask her out next? Or are you
gonna give up?"
dialogues.text:
"So? Where are you going to ask her out next? Or are you
gonna give up?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ、その点は抜かりはない」
dialogues.en: "Ha, don't worry about that."
dialogues.text: "Ha, don't worry about that."

dialogues.jp: しゃきーん、と笑顔を浮かべる。
dialogues.en: He gives a big shining smile.
dialogues.text: He gives a big shining smile.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今日はな、俺が｛こんい／懇意｝にしているサークルに誘っ
　てみようと思っている」
dialogues.en:
"Today, I'm gonna ask to take her out to a channeling
investigation club that I always go to."
dialogues.text:
"Today, I'm gonna ask to take her out to a channeling
investigation club that I always go to."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「サークル？」
dialogues.en:
"She will cheer up once she touches the energy of the
universe."
dialogues.text:
"She will cheer up once she touches the energy of the
universe."

dialogues.jp:
何やら不吉な予感がして、思わず聞き返してし
まった。

まっはっはと脳天気に笑う杉並に、俺はしみじ
みと言った。
dialogues.en: He's laughing optimistically, so I tell him,
dialogues.text: He's laughing optimistically, so I tell him,

dialogues.jp: 「杉並よ。……それだけは、止めておけ」
dialogues.en: "Suginami...... Please promise me you wouldn't do that."
dialogues.text: "Suginami...... Please promise me you wouldn't do that."

dialogues.jp: ◆寝顔◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
いつもの朝。目覚めると頼子さんがいて、寝顔
を見てましたなんていわれちゃったりして……。
なんだか照れてしまうよな……。
dialogues.en: "......Good morning."
dialogues.text: "......Good morning."

dialogues.jp: 家を出て学校に向かう途中、杉並に出会う。
dialogues.en: "Good morning......"
dialogues.text: "Good morning......"

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、二人でくだらないことを話し
ながらも俺は考えていた。
dialogues.en:
When I open my eyes, Yoriko-san's face is unexpectedly
there.
dialogues.text:
When I open my eyes, Yoriko-san's face is unexpectedly
there.

dialogues.jp:
どうしたら頼子さんを外に連れ出してあげられ
るのだろうか……と
dialogues.en: "Mmm, mmm......"
dialogues.text: "Mmm, mmm......"
